entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order is 785-21B.
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes. Is this the item you're calling about?
Yes, it is.
Alright. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They're awful. I took them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I know how painful that can be. Did you have your cleats installed when you tried them?
Of course I had the cleats installed. They're cycling shoes. I just want a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. I see here you received the delivery 15 days ago.
And? Is that a problem?
Not at all. According to our policy, standard items like these shoes are eligible for return within 90 days. So you are well within the window.
Fine. So you can actually do it then.

Yes, I can. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, we will process your full refund to the original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the email arrives.
It has been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Was there anything else I could help you with today, Mark?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
